capabilities.why: Snapshots provide atomic microVM memory and disk checkpointing before executing untrusted packages or flaky reproduction scripts, enabling instant zero-loss rollback to a clean state when step 7 fails.
Safety hooks inspect and validate all terminal commands against malicious patterns and data leakage vectors prior to microVM execution, preemptively blocking prompt-injected exfiltration attempts.

Network egress policies enforce strict zero-outbound rules or domain-restricted firewalls around untrusted detonation microVMs, preventing malicious packages or prompt injections from exfiltrating environment credentials.
